trigger: SSgt. Boone's back door at the Sparks yard depot (trader).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Behind a boxcar at the Sparks yard: a supply sergeant with a cigarette and a very clean smile.

nodes.speaker: trader_boone
nodes.text: Tyrell Boone. Staff sergeant. I'm the guy who knows what fell off the truck. Lots fell off the truck.

nodes.speaker: trader_boone
nodes.text: MREs. Filters. Five-five-six. All very lost, all very available. I want cigarettes, whiskey, and silence.

nodes.speaker: trader_boone
nodes.text: Pleasure. Filters are fresh. Mostly. Probably.

nodes.speaker: trader_boone
nodes.text: Enjoy. Chili-mac is the good one. Don't let anybody tell you different.

nodes.speaker: trader_boone
nodes.text: My CO knows the war's lost and the trucks are full. We all know. Want to buy something or not?

nodes.speaker: trader_boone
nodes.text: Come back with an ID or something to drink. I'm here 'til I'm not.
